title: First we need our shoes, then our water bottles.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: What do we need to bring before the park?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: First we need our shoes, then our water bottles.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: And what else do we need?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: We need our hats, too. As soon as we're ready, we can go.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Then you should hurry up and get ready.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I am hurrying, just the slow way.

variations: "shoes/water bottles" 换 "snacks/hats"；"we go" 换 "we leave"。
